questions.question: A normal Zeeman effect experiment uses a light source emitting a spectral line at wavelength λ = 500 nm placed in a uniform magnetic field of B = 1.0 T. What is the magnitude of the wavelength splitting Δλ between adjacent Zeeman components?

An X-ray beam with wavelength λ = 0.154 nm undergoes first-order (n = 1) Bragg reflection from the (111) crystallographic planes of a cubic crystal at a Bragg angle θ = 19.2°. What is the lattice constant 'a' of this cubic crystal?
A hollow air-filled rectangular metallic waveguide has internal cross-sectional dimensions of a = 3.0 cm and b = 1.5 cm. What is the cutoff frequency for the dominant TE10 mode?

An atomic state has a mean lifetime of τ = 2.0 ns. According to Heisenberg's uncertainty principle (ΔE Δt ≥ ħ/2), what is the minimum energy uncertainty ΔE of the emitted photon when the atom transitions to its ground state?

A Newtonian fluid flows under laminar conditions through a cylindrical pipe of radius R driven by a constant pressure gradient. If the pipe radius is reduced by 20% while maintaining the same pressure difference and pipe length, by approximately what percentage does the volumetric flow rate decrease?
